title: Advanced Redux Concepts
description: Explore advanced Redux patterns including custom hooks, store composition, and performance optimization.
longDescription: Once you're comfortable with the basics, this module explores production-grade patterns: custom hooks for reusable logic, store initialization and hydration for persisted state, performance optimization with memoized selectors, and code-splitting with dynamic reducers. These techniques are essential for large-scale Redux applications.
whatYouLearn: Encapsulate Redux logic in custom hooks
Hydrate the store from persisted state
Compose multiple stores for large apps
